raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Rows from the v2 collector carry txn_ts in UTC, but silver_transactions treats every txn_ts as America/Chicago local time, so v2 rows are shifted about 6 hours forward. That moves evening local transactions into 00:00-06:00 and assigns them to the next business date, which explains the 2026-01-19 volume spike and the off-hours timestamps. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago in silver fixes the dates, and the gold tables rebuild from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
